title: Heddle pacing configuration
description: Workspace dispatch capacity shared by lifecycle and subagent sessions.

defaultProvider.description: Provider used when a task or stage does not select one.

maxConcurrentSessions.description: Maximum total active lifecycle and subagent sessions in the workspace.

providerBudgets.description: Provider usage limits keyed by provider identifier. Missing providers have no usage limit.

maxDepth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Top-level sessions have depth zero.

maxFanOut.description: Maximum active child sessions for one parent session.

usageWindowHours.description: Provider usage window length. Heddle v1 uses five-hour windows.

usageLimit.description: Maximum usage in the units reported by the provider usage source.
